headline: GDX SURGES 21% AS MINERS TRIPLE BULLION MOVE — GDXJ +22%; Agnico +22.9%, Newmont +20.6%, Barrick +19.2%
snippet: The VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) surged 21.09% over five trading days to $89.73 per share on September 4, 2026, while GDXJ climbed 22.42% to $116.78, as gold equities amplified Friday's 2%+ bullion rally triggered by the August Non-Farm Payrolls miss. Agnico Eagle added 22.92% to C$250.17, Newmont gained 20.55% to $112.97, and Barrick climbed 19.22% to C$61.34 — a broad-based re-rating consistent with miners' historical 2-3x leverage to bullion moves, with GDX still trading at just 11.2x forward earnings against its 5-year average of 14x.

headline: FORD BREAKS GROUND ON RING OF FIRE ROAD — Five Years Early; Nickel, Copper, Chromite Corridor Under Construction
snippet: Ontario Premier Doug Ford and Marten Falls First Nation Chief Bruce Achneepineskum broke ground September 3, 2026 on the Marten Falls Community Access Road — five years ahead of the original schedule — opening all-season road access to one of the world's most significant undeveloped critical minerals regions. The Ring of Fire hosts billions of dollars of nickel, copper, chromite, platinum, and palladium; the road eliminates the historically prohibitive logistics barrier that has kept exploration-stage Ring of Fire assets from advancing toward production feasibility.

headline: LME COPPER SQUEEZE: 42-DAY INVENTORY SLIDE — $434 Cash Premium; Half Of Warrants Cancelled; Bidding War Looms
snippet: The LME copper market tightened dramatically in early September 2026 as on-warrant inventories fell for a 42nd consecutive trading day — the longest uninterrupted drawdown since 2014 — with the cash-to-three-month spread widening to $434 per tonne and nearly half of remaining warehouse stocks already cancelled for delivery. Copper was trading near $6.59/lb ($14,500/tonne) as persistent tariff-driven U.S.-bound flows and a Middle East sulfuric acid shortage compound what analysts argue is a structural multi-year supply deficit.

headline: PALADIN PLS PUNCHES NEW ZONE 100m EAST OF TRIPLE R — 0.7% Uranium Over 3.4m; Athabasca Resource Boundary Extended
snippet: Paladin Energy Ltd (ASX/TSX: PDN) announced September 2 that exploration drilling at Patterson Lake South (PLS) in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin has intersected a new high-grade uranium zone approximately 100 metres east of the current R1515W Mineral Resource at Triple R, with hole PLS26-779 returning 12.7 metres of total composite mineralization including 3.4 metres grading 0.7% eU3O8. The PLS Project targets approximately 9 million pounds of annual uranium production over a 10-year mine life from 93 million pounds of stated reserves; the new intersection beyond the current resource boundary indicates the Triple R zone remains open for expansion.

headline: COLLECTIVE MINING'S ORION NOW DRILL-READY IN COLOMBIA — 350m Footprint, Gold-Silver Geochemistry + Porphyry Anomaly
snippet: Collective Mining Ltd. (TSX: CNL) announced September 3 that the Orion target at its Guayabales Project in Caldas, Colombia has advanced to drill-ready status, with mapping outlining a 350 metre by 300 metre mineralized footprint in argillic- and sericite-altered quartz diorite hosting gold-bearing quartz-iron oxide stockwork veining coincident with strong surface gold-silver geochemistry and a discrete magnetic anomaly. Drilling commences immediately, with the Victory porphyry-breccia target — where reinterpretation of existing data has generated new precious metal targets — scheduled for Q4-2026.

headline: METAL ENERGY NIV GOES TO TWO RIGS — 4,200m Complete At Toodoggone BC Copper-Gold Porphyry; Assays Pending
snippet: Metal Energy Corp. (TSXV: MERG) announced September 3 that a second diamond drill rig has been mobilized to the NIV copper-gold porphyry project in British Columbia's Toodoggone District — the same belt hosting Kemess South/North and Mount Milligan — with six holes totalling approximately 4,200 metres of the planned 6,000-metre inaugural 2026 drill program completed and assay results pending. The addition of a second rig for the remaining roughly four weeks of the season signals management conviction based on what has been encountered so far; NIV hosts coincident soil geochemistry, IP chargeability, and airborne magnetic anomalies across approximately five kilometres of strike length that has never been drilled.

headline: DRYDEN GOLD HITS 9.40 g/t OVER 4.60m AT NEW 330m DEPTH RECORD — Spyglass Zone Extended; All 4 Holes Hit Visible Gold
snippet: Dryden Gold Corp. (TSXV: DRY) reported September 1 that deeper drilling at the Spyglass zone within the Gold Rock Project in northwestern Ontario returned 9.40 g/t gold over 4.60 metres including 78.40 g/t gold over 0.38 metres, extending the zone from approximately 190 metres to 330 metres vertical depth and roughly doubling the interpreted mineralized footprint; simultaneously the adjacent Buccaneer zone extended from 185 to 370 metres depth, with all four holes encountering visible gold. Gold Rock now contains 15 distinct mineralized structures across a target area exceeding one kilometre by 750 metres, supporting the multi-zone high-grade system interpretation underpinning the CA$17.5 million 2026/27 drill campaign.

headline: GOLD STOCKS AUTUMN RALLY '26 — 33% In August, 11x Earnings; Record Cash Flows + Seasonal Pattern Signal Next Leg
snippet: GoldSeek's autumn rally analysis argues that September-October represents gold equities' most consistent seasonal uplift period historically, and that the 2026 setup is unusually favorable: miners already gained 33% in August alone — three times the bullion move — while GDX still trades at 11.2 times forward earnings against a five-year average of 14 times, implying a 25% re-rating gap before accounting for the record operating cash flows miners will report in Q3. The analyst argues that August's surge was a catch-up move, not a blow-off top, and that fund flows into the sector are in the early innings of a reallocation.

headline: GOLD SWOT: PALLADIUM JOINS PRECIOUS METALS RALLY — September Hike Odds Collapse On Weak Jobs; Gold Holds $4,487
snippet: Sprott's weekly Gold SWOT report via GoldSeek identifies the August Non-Farm Payrolls miss as the key strength driver for precious metals on September 4, with gold holding $4,487 and palladium breaking out alongside silver as the Fed's September rate hike probability collapsed from approximately 66% to 45%. Palladium — which had been disconnected from the broader precious metals rally due to auto sector demand uncertainty — is now joining gold and silver's breakout on the same macro thesis of fiscal concerns and dollar weakness, broadening the number of metals responding to the monetary tailwind.

headline: SILVER MINERS ETF SIL BEATS PHYSICAL GOLD 86.6% TO 35.5% IN ONE YEAR — When To Own Equity Vs. Metal
snippet: The Global X Silver Miners ETF (SIL) delivered an 86.6% total return over the trailing 12 months ending September 1, 2026, compared with 35.5% for the Goldman Sachs Physical Gold ETF — outperforming by more than 50 percentage points — but with nearly double the maximum drawdown, reflecting the additional operational and management risk of equity versus physical metal exposure. The analysis frames the trade-off as a conviction decision: investors who believe the structural silver thesis (six consecutive supply deficits, China's strategic reclassification, industrial demand growth) is intact accept higher volatility through SIL; capital preservation-focused investors hold the metal itself.

headline: THISTLE RESOURCES BEGINS MIDDLE RIVER GOLD DRILLING — 3,000m NB Program Underway; First Pad On MRG Upper Zone
snippet: Thistle Resources Corp. (TSXV: TRCG) announced September 3 that its drill rig is on site and has begun the first hole of its 3,000-metre 2026 drill program at the Middle River Gold Project in New Brunswick's Bathurst Mining Camp — a historically productive base and precious metals region hosting several past-producing mines and active programs including SLAM Exploration's adjacent Goodwin copper-nickel-cobalt project. The program targets the MRG Upper Zone, where previous results include grab samples grading up to 27.3 g/t gold, with the Company intending to generate assay results before the end of the 2026 exploration season.
